subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should direct `CronService.add` callers using `current` or `session:*` receive the same implicit announce delivery as normalized gateway and agent-tool creation paths?
rationale: The patch is internally consistent, but it changes observable default delivery for a supported direct-service entry point; code inspection cannot determine whether that compatibility change is the intended public contract.

options.title: Confirm shared default
options.body: Confirm that direct-service creation must match normalized creation, accepting announce delivery as the default for `current` and `session:*` jobs.

options.title: Keep direct creation explicit
options.body: Retain the existing direct-service behavior and require direct callers to provide delivery explicitly until a separately designed API contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Confirm shared default
recommendation.body: Confirm that direct-service creation must match normalized creation, accepting announce delivery as the default for `current` and `session:*` jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged persistent-session-target work is the closest available provenance for the target semantics.
